rules.statement: Where there is any doubt, it is presumed that the direct substitution is intended.
rules.supporting_quote: "Where it is matter of doubt whether a fidei commissum has been imposed or not, that construction should rather be adopted which will give the legatee or heir the property unburdened", per de Villiers C.J., in Cruse v. Pretorius [2 6 Leader Law Rep.12] Executors.. 9B , 124.
